text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One forecast of Primary D5 (signed-MW six), issued at 12:00 UTC on 2026-03-10, against observed cleaned power, in percent of capacity. Band: q05 to q95 of the stored normal-running forecast. Orange line: its median. Blue line: the median of the G-lb corrected forecast. The origin is chosen as an event-free example, not as the best case. Lines break where telemetry is missing.'
text.tspan: One forecast of Primary D5 (signed-MW six), issued at 12:00 UTC on 2026-03-10, against observed
cleaned power, in percent of capacity. Band: q05 to q95 of the stored normal-running forecast.
Orange line: its median. Blue line: the median of the G-lb corrected forecast. The origin is
chosen as an event-free example, not as the best case. Lines break where telemetry is missing.
